To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The Learning Experience Instrument in Courses (LEIC) is an easily administered, reliable, valid, and sensitive instrument that measures the clarity of students’ perceptions of their teaching and learning environment, which is a key aspect of good teaching.
students' perceptions of the clarity of their learning experience are positively associated with high deep, and low surface approaches.
students who are clear in their perceptions of the learning environment are more likely to adopt a deep approach to learning and to achieve higher grades.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new, reliable, and valid instrument to assess the clarity of students' perception of their teaching/ learning environment, and to examine its association with students' approaches to learning.
the quality of teaching, and the quality of students' experience of teaching.
the development and validation of a short instrument that can be administered to students in class in order to assess the quality and clarity of the teaching/learning environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LEI C is an instrument that can be recommended for use in quality enhancement of teaching in Hong Kong universities.
the LEI C has been found to be a reliable and valid instrument that can be effectively used to assess the clarity of students' perception of their learning experience.
the LEI C is an instrument that is valid and reliable for use in assessing the quality of teaching.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
students' perceptions of the clarity of their teaching/ learning environment are an important aspect of good teaching, and can be measured with a simple and reliable instrument.
the LEI C has the potential to provide a useful tool for the QA of teaching.
the LEI C is an instrument with good reliability and construct validity that can be used for QA and especially for QE of teaching in higher education.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LEI C is useful as an instrument to assess the effectiveness of teaching and to identify areas for improvement.
it is important to assess the quality and impact of teaching on learning in the context of the specific courses in which students are enrolled.
the LEI C can be used as a diagnostic tool to assess and improve the clarity of students' perception of the learning experience, which in turn can enhance students' approaches to learning.
